enum DiaryTheme: String, CaseIterable, Sendable {
    case twilight, ocean, jade, rose, amber, glass
    var label: String {
        switch self {
        case .twilight: "Twilight"
        case .ocean: "Ocean"
        case .jade: "Jade"
        case .rose: "Rose"
        case .amber: "Amber"
        case .glass: "Liquid Glass"
        }
    }
    var accentHex: String {
        switch self {
        case .twilight: "#b795f6"
        case .ocean: "#82b8ff"
        case .jade: "#79d8bc"
        case .rose: "#f4a2c6"
        case .amber: "#edbe73"
        case .glass: "#c4e5ff"
        }
    }
    var accent: Color { Color(webHex: accentHex) }
}

extension Color {
    init(webHex: String) {
        let raw = webHex.trimmingCharacters(in: CharacterSet(charactersIn: "#"))
        let value = UInt64(raw, radix: 16) ?? 0
        let alpha: Double = raw.count == 8 ? Double(value & 255) / 255 : 1
        let rgb = raw.count == 8 ? value >> 8 : value
        self.init(.sRGB, red: Double((rgb >> 16) & 255) / 255, green: Double((rgb >> 8) & 255) / 255, blue: Double(rgb & 255) / 255, opacity: alpha)
    }
}
